name: The Shared Drain
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: encyclopedia cover illustration for Avarenne, a mature late-industrial occult fantasy novel. Scene: Sealed laboratory service corridor, one insulated containment chamber behind a closed inspection window and a separate transparent clinical drain with small pale organic nodules, two distinct pipe routes visibly joining incorrectly at a service junction, warning lanterns, no giant creature. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, tactile architecture and believable materials, dramatic but readable light, atmospheric depth. One coherent scene, landscape 3:2. Show only the specified bounded manifestation; supernatural graphic traces are illustrative, never game interface. Anonymous adult figures only when specified, no named canonical character. No legible text, numbers, labels, logo, watermark, card frame or collage. No additional creature, portal, deity, avatar or city-wide catastrophe. Avoid exaggerating the effect beyond its local source.
visual_caption: Cella superiore e drenaggio clinico hanno sorgenti diverse, anche quando condividono un servizio. Ricostruzione illustrativa, non prova diagnostica o fonte di nuove capacità.
